notes.title: Demo Update! Bug Fixes and Movement Speed!
notes.notes:
We're so happy to hear you've been enjoying our demo! Here's a small update to address some bugs and add more movement speed options.

Also, we want to assure you that the full game will be much more challenging than the demo! This is the type of game that requires dying many times to learn strategy and earn ways to make the next run easier. Or even harder, if you're into that!

We are a smaller team and balancing a deck builder takes time and patience, so thank you again for your feedback. By the way, how many of you found the secret event hinted at in our demo launch trailer?

Changes include:

[list]
[*] New option to turn off movement arrows
[*] Sliders for movement speed and rotate speed
[*] New option toggles for hold to rotate and hold to move
[*] You no longer see a run log tutorial if you die
[*] Multi-attacks update the health bar multiple times
[*] Multi-attacks stop if the attacker dies during them
[*] Brightness settings do not reset on a new run
[*] Coin icon added to gold rewards from events
[*] Options text scrambling randomly is fixed
[*] You can no longer gain extra regen by clicking End Turn after all enemies are defeated
[*] Minor fixes to typos and text color
[/list]

Find the secret event hinted in the demo launch trailer:
[previewyoutube=LMiEZnJxi7I;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 👻🏨 THE SPIRIT LIFT demo launches Wednesday, June 5th!
notes.notes:
[h1]Your key to Vexington Hotel is here. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1727590/THE_SPIRIT_LIFT/]Unlock the new demo to THE SPIRIT LIFT now![/url][/h1]

👻🏨THE SPIRIT LIFT is a ghostpunk deckbuilder roguelike set in a haunted hotel. You’ll be playing a group of teens surviving and thriving as they battle monsters and explore mysteries with the help of a mystic elevator! The demo is a preview of the full game which will have even more monsters, floors, cards, and characters. 

[h2]Start your ride on THE SPIRIT LIFT with the new demo trailer![/h2]
[previewyoutube=LMiEZnJxi7I;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1727590/THE_SPIRIT_LIFT/]Play 👻🏨 THE SPIRIT LIFT on Steam now![/url][/h1]

Love the music from the game? THE SPIRIT LIFT: Demo Soundtrack by Ryako is available on [url=https://ryako.bandcamp.com/album/the-spirit-lift-demo-soundtrack]Ryako's Bandcamp[/url] and the soundtrack will be [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3020420/THE_SPIRIT_LIFT_Demo_Soundtrack/]coming soon to Steam![/url]  It includes 5 tracks that are expertly remixed to enjoy outside the game. 

Our small, scrappy indie studio look forward to your feedback and is so happy to share a little slice of the game with you. We want to express our deepest gratitude to anyone who has added the game to their wishlist, watched a [url=https://www.twitch.tv/drmikachu]Twitch[/url] stream of the creation, signed up for [url=https://prettysmartgames.us18.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=d15c1d7b2930908cb83c6143c&id=e2923b14a7]our mailing list[/url], joined our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nrTTyjj]Discord[/url], followed us on [url=https://linktr.ee/prettysmartgames]social media[/url], and spread the word about our game! These actions help us continue to create projects we love and games we want to see in the world.
